method: Numeric rules and control-flow facts inspected in public scripts; no original code copied into game. Native UnitPhysics find_best_enemy/repulsion still unmeasured.

verified_script_facts.idle_acquire: resource aggro range; allied ranged overrides to attack range
verified_script_facts.scan: 0.1s base plus random stagger; additional six-frame scheduling in original
verified_script_facts.retarget: while pursuing and farther than2*effective_attack_range, every0.15s inspect8*unit_size radius and choose a better target
verified_script_facts.ranged_retarget_score: distance squared + assigned ranged target count*1500
verified_script_facts.braking: inside speed*0.4 (mounted0.85), multiply desired speed by distance/braking_distance
verified_script_facts.light_cavalry_role: Roles include mobile and shock; primary role gives mobile priority, so default AI task is flank, not automatic charge
verified_script_facts.director: 1.5s evaluation,3s order cooldown,500 flank offset,180 ranged standoff; full role director not yet implemented
